name: Frieze and register layouts
description: Narrative layouts from the traditions' own art: a horizontal frieze of panels that travels from panel to panel (vase frieze, Oseberg procession, Phad episodes) and stacked registers read top-down (folios) or bottom-up (Gotland picture stones), revealed in reading order.

inputs.name: visible
inputs.description: Frieze panels in view at once

implementation.api: M.frieze(parent, {panels, visible}) + M.friezeTo(tl, fr, at, index); M.registers(parent, {rows, order}) ; M.panelsIn(tl, panels, at, {from})

validation.evidence: tests/test-mythic.py (Playwright Chromium: every figure in four looks, stepped poses, frieze and registers, tradition presets, seek determinism) and frame review of the four style-sample-mythic-* projects on Windows, 2026-11-23. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2 host.
